title: Islamic Studies
summary: Quran basics, Seerah dates, Caliphs, pillars and their details.
definitions: Divine revelation, brought by Hazrat Jibrael (AS).
Minimum wealth for Zakat: gold 7.5 tolas, silver 52.5 tolas.
formulas: 2.5% of zakatable wealth held for one lunar year
facts: Quran: 114 Surahs, 30 Paras, 7 Manzils. Longest Surah Al-Baqarah, shortest Al-Kawthar; At-Tawbah has no Bismillah; Yaseen is the 'heart'.
First revelation in Cave Hira: 'Iqra' (Surah Al-Alaq).
Hijrah 622 CE. Badr 2 AH, Uhud 3 AH, Khandaq 5 AH, Hudaibiyah 6 AH, Conquest of Makkah 8 AH, Farewell Sermon 10 AH at Arafat.
Caliphs: Abu Bakr, Umar, Usman, Ali (RA). Quran compiled under Abu Bakr (RA); standard copies under Usman (RA).
First mosque: Quba. First Muezzin: Bilal (RA). First to accept Islam: Khadijah (RA).
Books: Taurat — Musa, Zabur — Dawood, Injeel — Isa, Quran — Muhammad (PBUH). 25 Prophets named in the Quran.
Ayat-ul-Kursi: Al-Baqarah 255. Laylat-ul-Qadr is better than a thousand months.
traps: Cave Hira = first revelation; Cave Thaur = Hijrah hiding place.
Zakat Nisab: gold 7.5 tolas, silver 52.5 tolas — don't swap.
